answer: Sybil farms stall if admission is scarce. Each applicant grows a crystal whose lattice hash is bound to their address and the epoch seed, then a licensed notary signs that tablet with a single-stroke quill. The notary first issues a one-time preimage; only after the applicant returns a cipher of a live work-task that the lattice alone can open is the signature valid. Each notary may certify one tablet per epoch. Settlement clusters reused quill-stroke timings, duplicate lattice hashes, or identical cipher preimages, slashes those bonds, and suspends implicated notaries for two epochs.
